claims.claim: Tofacitinib is a Janus kinase inhibitor that worked in UC trials

claims.reason: All JAKinibs most potently inhibit JAK1 pathways.

claims.claim: Tofacitinib acts more than filgotinib on JAK2- and JAK3-dependent pathways
claims.quote: but with less inhibition of JAK2-dependent and JAK3-dependent pathways
claims.reason: Filgotinib inhibits JAK2/JAK3 pathways less than other JAKinibs including tofacitinib.

claims.claim: Filgotinib is a JAK1-preferential inhibitor that worked in UC
